wu: Goal Bingo: Students get a bingo grid with 9 simple semester 1 words (e.g., 'school', 'friend', 'pizza'). Teacher calls out definitions or shows pictures, students mark the word and say it aloud when they get a line.
wuAlt: Word Chain: Students say a word from S1, next student says a word starting with the last letter, e.g., 'book' → 'kite' → 'elephant'.
Flashcard Race: Two lines of students race to slap the flashcard the teacher names (e.g., 'Show me red!')
pres: Teacher shows a New Year's resolution poster with 'I want to...' and 'I will try...' (e.g., 'I want to learn English', 'I will try to read more'). Models 3 examples, asks students to repeat. Checks understanding with thumbs up/down: 'Do you want to learn English?'
presAlt: Goal Charades: Teacher acts out a goal (e.g., 'running'), students guess and complete the sentence: 'You want to...'.
Story Time: Show a short comic strip of a teen making a resolution, students identify the goal language.
prac: Goal-Setting One-Pager: Students fold a paper into 4 sections. In each, they draw/write one S1 topic (e.g., food, school) and a goal using 'I want to... I will try...'. Teacher monitors, helps with spelling.
pracAlt: Goal Match-Up: Cards with 'I want to...' on one side and activities (e.g., 'do homework') on the other. Students match pairs and make sentences.
Pair Drill: Student A says a goal, Student B asks 'Why?', Student A answers 'Because I want to...'
ls: Listen and Match: Audio of 4 teens saying goals (e.g., 'I want to play football'). Students match each voice to a picture of the activity on their worksheet.
re: Stand Up If...: Teacher calls out goals (e.g., 'Stand up if you want to learn English!'), students stand and repeat the sentence.
prod: Goal Survey: Students walk around asking 3 peers 'What do you want to learn this year?' and write down their answers. Report back: 'Fatima wants to...'
rw: S1 Review Paragraph: Students read a short text about a teen's semester (e.g., 'I go to school. I have friends. I can play football'). Circle 3 things they can do. Then write 3 sentences about their own semester.
st: Song: Play 'Auld Lang Syne' instrumental, teach students to hum along. End with: 'Today we talked about goals. Thank you, class! Goodbye!'
g: Students mark S1 words on a grid as teacher calls them.
Two lines race to slap the correct S1 flashcard.
Match 'I want to...' cards to activity pictures.
Stand and repeat goal sentences when called.
Ask peers about goals and report back.
diff: Fast finishers: Draw a comic strip of someone achieving their goal.
Support: Trace or copy goal sentences from the board.
hw: Write 3 learning goals for the year: 'I want to... I will try...'
Draw a picture of one goal and write a sentence under it.
Ask a family member their goal and write it down.
tip: Use local context: link goals to Moroccan events like Green March or Independence Day to increase relevance, e.g., 'I want to learn about Moroccan history.'
